dedupe_keys.name: feasibility study for 100 renewable energy microgrids with medium sized wind turbines in switzerland

description: Sarah Barber and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed modelling study evaluates twelve Swiss settings for fully renewable microgrids. Five are reported feasible under the stated assumptions, with an independence premium of about USD 0.20 per kWh and the source-defined SSR range from one to two. The work includes a Glarus high-performance-computing application. These are modelled feasibility and cost outcomes, not evidence that the proposed installations were constructed. The case supports investment appraisal within its technology, demand and price assumptions. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
